A_mem.data_reference: definitional; the soma membrane area 3000 um^2 (used when unconnected; in a soma it comes from the membrane through the membrane_area port)

rho_NaCa.data_reference: hilgemann1991charge; Abstract: Na+-induced charge movements indicate ~400 exchangers per um^2 in guinea-pig (cardiac) sarcolemma, giant patches (= value; set on review 2026-10-05, was 124830 /um^2, which reproduced the old k_NaCa 300 nA). Cardiac proxy: no neuronal NCX density found. With r_NaCa 5000 /s (same sentence: maximal I_NaCa 20-30 uA/cm^2) and A = 3000 um^2, k_NaCa = 0.96 nA. In rat SCG neurons NCX is a minor Ca-extrusion path (PMCA dominant; wanaverbecq2003plasma)

r_NaCa.data_reference: hilgemann1991charge; cardiac Na/Ca exchanger turnover ~5,000 /s (one net charge per cycle) (Abstract)
